svg.title: Where the time of a synchronous plug-in step goes
svg.desc: A horizontal time bar for one save of a case that sets priority High, before and after optimisation. Before: about 30 milliseconds to start the step, a Retrieve with all columns, a query without row limit, then 40 Update calls each of which runs the work order pipeline with four more steps, for about 3.4 seconds in total, above the 2 second guidance. After: early exit checks from images take under a millisecond, one capped query that returns only rows that differ, at most 25 minimal updates that start one filtered step each which returns on the guard token, about 0.9 seconds. Below the bars a ladder lists the order of optimisation: do not run, run later, read less, write less, hold locks briefly, measure.
